key_insight: Semantically similar tasks should be clustered before joint training so cooperative multi-task learning stays constructive instead of causing negative transfer.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical way to improve multi-task communication systems by automatically grouping compatible tasks and training only within those groups.
method: Short initial training to learn task representations.
Hierarchical density-based clustering to discover semantically aligned task groups.
End-to-end joint training performed separately inside each cluster.
evidence_signal: Simulation results in the abstract report higher accuracy than both unclustered multi-tasking and individual-task baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the initial representations and clustering stage, so poor early embeddings could misgroup tasks and reduce gains.
paper_title: Semantic-Aware Task Clustering for Constructive and Cooperative Multi-Tasking
